status: Provisional implementation-led observations, not binding specifications
excludedInputs: All previous OpenAPI binding drafts and their derivative expectation sets

observations.candidateSharedMeaning: Source values, retrieval identity and reference bases need a defined interpretation for a selected kind.
observations.deliberateSilenceOrPolicy: Text storage, explicit resource layouts, caching and acquisition mechanism are implementation choices. The new headerless fragment fixture needs client ResourceLayout metadata; this is not a portability rule.

observations.candidateSharedMeaning: The mounted entry path and method identify the selected operation in these experiments.
observations.deliberateSilenceOrPolicy: Naming, inventory order, lookup data structures and public labels remain authoring/design choices.

observations.candidateSharedMeaning: Location-qualified caller values and absence versus null have observable wire meaning.
observations.deliberateSilenceOrPolicy: Closed-envelope checks, duplicate-name admission and budget sizes remain implementation policy. 3.0 nullable parameter exclusion is a capability limit, not a version prohibition.

observations.candidateSharedMeaning: Chosen output/error mapping and complete delivery evidence are observable.
observations.deliberateSilenceOrPolicy: Buffering and transport are choices. Retry/redirect mechanisms can stay silent only where they preserve the promised observable effects; not blanket permission for extra effects.

observations.candidateSharedMeaning: Each selected context point and value must have an unambiguous interpretation.
observations.deliberateSilenceOrPolicy: This experiment gives each family its own point. Independent points are not automatically required for every future family. Challenge encoding, UX and persistence stay outside the spec.

observations.candidateSharedMeaning: The selected one-value-then-close contract and effect/error meaning require shared interpretation.
observations.deliberateSilenceOrPolicy: Channel/executor/polling implementation is silent. Reuse existing generic role lifecycle meaning.

observations.candidateSharedMeaning: Synthesis must describe its actual projection and cannot treat strict eligibility as full schema fidelity.
observations.deliberateSilenceOrPolicy: No binding-spec requirement for naming, coverage algorithm or schema generation. This is implementation evidence and existing role meaning.

observations.candidateSharedMeaning: Interpret source references under their actual upstream edition and disclose uncertainty.
observations.deliberateSilenceOrPolicy: Conservative refusal is an implementation capability decision. Do not standardize upstream gaps from current client behavior.

observations.candidateSharedMeaning: Exact observable values and invocation meaning apply across hosts.
observations.deliberateSilenceOrPolicy: Languages, crates, JS/Wasm packaging, scheduling, cache and resource strategies remain outside binding rules.

observations.candidateSharedMeaning: A kind needs unambiguous source-version applicability: identical apparent fields can have different upstream meaning.
observations.deliberateSilenceOrPolicy: Separate private labels and dispatch through one internal Kind enum are experiment/implementation choices. No requirement for that enum, repository topology or final identifier spelling.
